class.name: NNBTDecoratorNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree decorator nodes.
class.description: A decorator wraps a single behaviour tree child to modify when it runs or what status it returns (for example, [NNBTInverter], [NNBTRepeater], [NNBTCooldown], or [NNBTTimeLimiter]). Give each decorator exactly one enabled behaviour tree child.
